verdict.rationale: Sharing TOTP logins with a team is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents syncing codes to the user's own Google Account and transferring them between devices by QR code. Nothing shows shared vaults, collections, or per-member access control.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control
